claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show any readable engine code/label (e.g., 2ZR) or gearbox identification.

risks.risk: Engine model/variant may not be 2ZR (wrong engine code or different Toyota family).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the engine code/label stamped on the engine block (and/or the VIN/engine number plate) plus a photo of the gearbox code/label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine/gearbox (worst case: not confirmed correct model).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: missing key components (starter, alternator, ECU, wiring harness, sensors, flywheel/torque converter, mounts).
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo showing all included parts, and a short video showing the engine/gearbox from multiple angles with what is attached.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: missing parts).

risks.risk: Condition risk: may be non-running, damaged internally, or has oil/water leaks.
risks.proof: Video of a test start (or compression/leak test results) and photos of oil pan area, coolant passages, and any cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: not working).

risks.risk: Gearbox condition risk: bad bearings/syncros, broken mounts, or wrong type (manual vs automatic).
risks.proof: Photo of gearbox type/label and a video showing the gearbox input/output shafts and any attached components; confirm manual/auto.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as gearbox condition unverified (worst case: not working).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine block code/engine number plate showing the exact code (2ZR) and location.
Close-up photo of the gearbox label/code showing type (manual/automatic) and model.
Video of the engine and gearbox being started/tested (or compression/leak test results).
Photos showing completeness: ECU, starter, alternator, sensors, wiring harness, mounts, and any included accessories.
response.reason: From photo 0, the engines/gearboxes are wrapped and no readable engine/gearbox codes are visible, so the claimed 2ZR identification and condition cannot be verified remotely. To price safely, we need the exact engine/gearbox labels and proof of working condition.
